parse.title: Umbra
parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable

Overview

Umbra is a Secret Limited unit. He can only be obtained by clearing the Nightmare Hunt with an estimated 0.5% chance, which increases up to 1% as you bring in Halloween 2023 units/skins.

Evolving

Umbra can evolve into Umbra (Nuclear) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Umbra
x1 Shadow Broadsword
x12 Star Fruit
x3 Star Fruit (Blue)
x4 Star Fruit (Red)
x4 Star Fruit (Pink)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)
Result
Umbra (Nuclear)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 5000 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
